svg.title: Whisper Push — DMG install window background
svg.desc: 640x480. Finder draws the app icon at (170,250), the Applications alias at (470,250) and their labels in the band y=312..340; those areas are left empty. Palette: Racing Green #0D2E25, Signal Citron #CEDC00, Chamois Cream #EFEAD8. All type is outlined — no font dependency.
